identity.message: RCO Identity 2.0.12: the clothing store saves again after an MP piece with a Color is picked back as its plain Variation. 2.0.11: an MP piece under another one can get or change its Color without taking the outer piece off (a vest under a coat). 2.0.10: the store's Color wheel is fast again when a colored piece left the character.

vehicles.message: RCO Vehicles 0.1.113: cars with a trunk (Ironhorse, Mule, Prairie) open it on foot behind them: the player lifts the lid, the trunk's inventory opens (RSG and VORP, old and new) and its size is set in Config.Trunks; a locked car keeps it shut. Also: the lock key in the config (Config.LockKey), /carreturn and /givekey, and the repair kit and cloth always taken on edited VORP inventories. Update your RCO cars too.

gym.message: RCO Gym 0.0.91: the pulley costs less while you train (the rope's pieces ride on its first one, only the last slides), the weight stacks and the hand bone are not asked again when nothing changed. 0.0.90: lighter for players watching someone train (the pulley ropes are drawn only by the one using it, equipment in another player's hands moved with less work, followed 10 times a second while he is off screen, who trains where read as it changes); the first-visit tips show once, one at a time. 0.0.89: skipping rope: every pass of the rope under the feet is a jump (a pass before the first one used to lose the rep). 0.0.88: new skipping rope minigame (the rope seen side on, it sweeps under the feet); tiredness as a bar, red when worn out, on the load picker and the record board; the horizontal ladder and the rope climb give less experience (Config.Progression.EasyShare). 0.0.87: any human character can train, server ped models too (the muscle on the body stays on the multiplayer bodies). 0.0.86: a set counts only from 5 good reps (Config.Progression.MinReps). 0.0.85: the record board and the load picker take the UI focus. 0.0.83: the exercises' animations play again. 0.0.82: the gym on the map (Config.Blip). 0.0.81: first release. A working 1890 gymnasium in Strawberry: 21 exercises on our own equipment, each with its own minigame; strength per muscle group with the muscle on the body (RCO Appearance, RSG Appearance or VORP Character); fatigue, warm-up and strains; wind for stamina and a harder punch; records, the week's champion and a spotter who can save your rep.
